_README: Human review of the model's content verdicts. classification.json stays exactly what the classifier returned; this file records where a hand check disagreed, and why, so both are auditable. Applied on top of classification.json by build-panel.ts and build-site.ts. Added only after fetching the site and reading it.
_method: Full census of all 53 excluded domains: homepage fetched, title and meta description read by hand. 4 were wrong exclusions, 2 were right exclusions under the wrong label. A 40-domain random sample (seeded shuffle) of the 1,405 kept domains found 0 wrong inclusions. Re-measured 2026-11-02 against a sorted, fingerprinted pool: two seeded draws, 127 distinct domains, 111 judged, 1 wrong keep (az24.vn). A hand census of all 189 drawn domains on 2026-11-02 added netkeiba.com.

dragonball-super.com.reason: Official Fuji TV site for the anime — title reads 公式サイト. The name reads like a fan piracy site; the page is the broadcaster's own.

strikerreport.com.reason: Independent football publication covering the World Cup, Premier League and MLS. No betting product.

i993.com.reason: Serves 'Surveza', a survey site. Nothing adult on the page.

izy0.com.reason: Serves 'Surveza', a survey site. Nothing adult on the page.

arbada.com.reason: Arabic pornography site. Excluded either way; the label was wrong.

txnhh.com.reason: Serves XNXX pornography. Excluded either way; the label was wrong.

az24.vn.reason: Lottery results site — title reads "Ket qua xo so ba mien" (three-region lottery results), with live draws, Vietlott and jackpot figures. The classifier said ok; found by the kept-side sample on 2026-11-02.

netkeiba.com.reason: Japan's largest horse-racing service — its own description offers JRA race cards, odds, tips, keirin and a betting-prediction contest. An odds and tips service is gambling under the rule. The classifier said ok and the English vocabulary scan could not see it; found by the hand census of 189 drawn domains on 2026-11-02.
